title: Schema S: scene script
description: A hand-written explanation as an explicit timeline, in the manner of Manim: shapes placed in the scene's own points, beats that act on them at given seconds, and camera keys. Read by style 2, the flowchart. Rust type: rain_lab::schema::scene::Scene.

size.description: The scene's own width and height, in points.

shapes.description: Every shape, hidden until a beat brings it in.

beats.description: The timeline, in order of t.

camera.description: Camera keys, in order of t; the camera eases between them.

id.description: Unique among the shapes; actions and [[id]] links name it.

kind.description: A component box, a caption or note, a line, a travelling dot, or a call's arrow.

at.description: Top-left for boxes and text, the start for paths and arrows, the centre for dots.

Props.description: Everything optional; each kind reads what it needs.

text.description: A box's or text's words, an arrow's call, a dot's value.

points.description: For paths and arrows, in scene points.

tone.description: What the change did to it; picks the colour and a box's tag. Absent means same.

actions.description: What happens at t, all at once.

say.description: What the beat shows, in a sentence; [[id]] names a shape. Without it the card lists the actions.

do.description: create grows it in; write draws strokes on and types text; transform changes size or shape; move travels to `to`; fade takes opacity from to[0] to to[1]; focus frames it and dims the rest (an empty target ends focus); pulse runs a dot along it; morph relabels it `into`.

target.description: A shape's id; empty only for focus, to end it.

to.description: move: where to, in scene points; fade: opacity from and to.

into.description: morph: the new label; text after ' · ' says what it now does.

center.description: Where the camera looks, in scene points.
